correctness.rationale: For every cyclic quadruple the largest pair-sum is identified algebraically and the four-point defect factors into two positive trigonometric products. Balancing opposite integer gaps gives a rigorous upper bound depending only on p=a+c; explicit adjacent-difference identities prove that bound increases to p=floor(n/2), and balanced terminal patterns attain it. The closed formulas are therefore proved for all n at least 4. Exhaustive enumeration through n=60 separately reproduces the theorem.
